head: Weather, Actually gives you the forecast in plain words
dek: Weather, Actually explains the forecast in plain words, with three detail levels from "Super basic" to "Nerd", and shows your state's weather in 3D. It was #36 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: No ads. It costs $2.99, by Walker Tracy.
means: If weather apps feel cluttered, this one tells you what to expect in a sentence.
todo: Find Weather, Actually in the App Store.
